text: Apparently "I'm not in the mood to be perceived" is not a valid reason to skip the team meeting.

Interviewer: Why do you want to work here?

Me: I've developed a strong interest in paying rent.

Locked in at work today.

Do not contact me for the next 12 minutes.

Work until I'm 65?

I'm not even sure I'll make it to lunch.

I can't tell my coworker their idea is terrible.

So I say "interesting... let's take that offline."
My job is 90% saying "happy to help" to things that make me deeply unhappy.

My work bestie isn't just a friend.

She's a witness.

Do I love my job? Some days.
Do I love my coworkers? Most of them.
Do I love my boss?

Next question.

My boss told me to think outside the box.

So I thought about leaving.

Some people find peace in yoga.

I find it when my boss is on PTO.

My résumé says "thrives under pressure."

My search history says "how to fake a sick voice."
Calling in sick takes more acting skill than anything I've ever done at this job.

Team building:

When your company makes you play games with the exact people you avoid all week.

"We're a fast-paced environment"

means nobody knows what's going on, but everyone is yelling about it.

Out of office: physically.

Emotionally, I left in 2022.
